The '''SS-39L''' was a variant of the [[SS-39 Space Skiff]] manufactured by [[Telex-Delcor/Legends|Telex-Delcor]]. The SS-39L differed from the standard model by mounting a [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat]] [[Vonak 21-Dx light laser cannon]].
